rationale: hammernik_2017-claude-agentic: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, max_train_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_2017 iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: vn_T 5 -> 2 (unroll depth DOWN, GENUINELY UNTRIED -- vn_T held at 5 every iter 1-7). BASE_ITER=7 (the BEST + best above-baseline point: SSIM 0.8170, hr 0.0375, vn_T5/ep10/bs1/lr5e-4/lambda0.0023/n_filters16). All else held at iter-7 (vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=2.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=5e-4, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=214, seed=42); max_train_s 1050 kept. TRAJECTORY (corrected metric): iter-1 OOM(bs4); iter-2 0.8012 hr0; iter-3 0.7932 hr0 (lambda 0.0023->0.05 UP REGRESSED); iter-4 0.7828 hr0 (n_filters 16->4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-5 0.8114 hr0.0319 KEEP (epochs 14->19 UP, FIRST above the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor); iter-6 0.7883 hr0 DISCARD (lr 5e-4->3e-4 DOWN REGRESSED); iter-7 0.8170 hr0.0375 KEEP (batch_size 2->1 DOWN, epochs traded to 10, NEW BEST). best hr=0.0375 @iter-7. MAPPED KNOBS: epochs(UP works), batch_size(DOWN works), lr(DOWN fails), vn_lambda_init(UP fails), vn_n_filters(DOWN fails). NEVER MAPPED: vn_T (unroll depth, held 5 every iter) + train_n (held 200 every iter). LIMITER (box2): OVER-UNROLLING re-injects the learned-regularizer smoothing term Sum_i K_i^T rho_i(K_i y) at every one of the 5 in-loop steps, dragging the FBP init below the floor -- the SAME mechanism that capped the sibling hammernik_vn at hr0 until vn_T 5->2 BROKE IT OUT to hr 0.1540 (and itnet/itnet_v2 via depth k=1). Prior epochs/bs levers only bought +0.006 crumbs to hr~0.037; depth is the unmapped breakout axis. NOT wall-bound: iter-7 ran in only 679.4s of the 1200s budget. ONE KNOB CHOICE (box3): vn_T 5->2 -- the FAMILY-PROVEN BREAKOUT lever (4 breakouts so far: hammernik_vn, itnet, itnet_v2 + the depth-down pattern), genuinely untried in THIS solver. epochs held at 10 (do NOT also raise epochs to spend the freed budget -- that would be a second knob; the headroom is safety margin). HYPOTHESIS (box4): with unroll depth 5->2 the regularizer re-injects 2.5x fewer times so the recon stays near the FBP init -> SSIM clears further above the floor mirroring hammernik_vn 0->0.1540; predict SSIM ~0.84-0.88, hr ~0.08-0.15. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.0375 (<= iter-7 best), depth is NOT this solvers breakout axis (unlike its sibling) -> iter-9 turns to the untried train_n UP data-coverage lever (the proven trainer lever, also unmapped here). BUDGET (box5, HARD 1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T 5->2 cuts the in-loop unrolled cost ~2.5x, so wall FAR below iter-7 679.4s -- the figure + score(214) stay comfortably in budget; max_train_s=1050 backstop, well under the 1800s SLURM kill. MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T DOWN holds FEWER (B,F,H,W) RBF-bump activation tensors across the unrolled loop than iter-7 -- strictly LIGHTER footprint; batch_size=1 KEPT (OOM-safe minimum; bs=4 OOMed the 16GB RTX5000 at iter-1), N_k=16, grad_clip=1.0 retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability).
